question: Which are the car makers which produce at least 2 models and more than 3 car makers ? List the id and the maker .
sql:
SELECT cm.Id, cm.Maker 
FROM car_makers cm 
JOIN model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker 
GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.Maker 
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ml.ModelId) >= 2 
AND cm.Id IN (
    SELECT Maker 
    FROM model_list 
    GROUP BY Maker 
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ModelId) >= 2
) 
AND (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Maker) 
    FROM (
        SELECT Maker 
        FROM model_list 
        GROUP BY Maker 
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ModelId) >= 2
    )
) > 3;

question: What are the id and names of the countries which have more than 3 car makers or produce the 'fiat' model?
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.CountryId, c.CountryName 
FROM countries c 
LEFT JOIN car_makers cm ON c.CountryId = cm.Country 
LEFT JOIN model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker AND ml.Model = 'fiat' 
GROUP BY c.CountryId, c.CountryName 
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.Id) > 3 OR SUM(CASE WHEN ml.Model = 'fiat' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

question: What are the ids and names of all countries that either have more than 3 car makers or produce fiat model ?
sql:
SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName 
FROM countries c 
LEFT JOIN car_makers cm ON c.CountryId = cm.Country 
LEFT JOIN model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker AND ml.Model = 'fiat' 
GROUP BY c.CountryId, c.CountryName 
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.Id) > 3 OR COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ml.Model = 'fiat' THEN ml.ModelId END) > 0

UNION

SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName 
FROM countries c 
JOIN car_makers cm ON c.CountryId = cm.Country 
JOIN model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker 
WHERE ml.Model = 'fiat';
